pieces.title: Rio de Janeiro Hotels: The Shortlist
pieces.keyword: best luxury hotels in rio de janeiro
pieces.why: Biggest-volume hotel query, zero Brazil content on site. 5 picks she saw: Janeiro, Fasano, Copacabana Palace, Fairmont, Santa Teresa MGallery. Peak: NYE (Dec) + Carnival 5-10 Feb 2027.

pieces.title: The Answer: Brazil or Argentina Side of Iguazú Falls?
pieces.keyword: iguazu falls brazil or argentina side
pieces.why: Perennial top Iguazú question; she has the Brazil side from inside the park. Peak: Dec-Jan (summer high water, Jan holidays).
slots: Argentina side or view across the river

pieces.title: The Verdict: Belmond Hotel das Cataratas, Iguazú Falls
pieces.why: Stayed 1 night. ~US$740-860/night (Superior from BRL 2,590) clears $700 floor. Only hotel inside the Brazil park. Peak: Dec-Mar season.

pieces.title: The Comparison: Copacabana vs Ipanema
pieces.keyword: copacabana or ipanema where to stay
pieces.why: Classic where-to-stay query; she stayed both ends (Fairmont Copacabana, Janeiro Leblon) and toured Fasano Ipanema + Palace. Peak: NYE bookings Nov-Dec.

pieces.title: The Verdict: Janeiro Hotel, Rio de Janeiro
pieces.why: Stayed room 131 ocean suite, rated 5. ~US$600-840/night; design-forward boutique, clears $400 floor. Little English-language depth. Peak: NYE/Carnival.

pieces.title: The Primer: Rio de Janeiro
pieces.why: Hub page every Rio piece links into; high-volume head term. Peaks: NYE (Réveillon, Dec) then Carnival 5-10 Feb 2027 (Jan searches).

pieces.title: The Answer: Do Americans Need a Visa for Brazil?
pieces.why: E-visa reinstated Apr 2025 (US$80.90, 10-yr); airlines deny boarding without it. Evergreen, high volume, catches pre-trip readers. Peak: Nov-Jan.

pieces.title: The Route: Five Days in Rio de Janeiro
pieces.keyword: 5 days in rio de janeiro itinerary
pieces.why: She had 6 days (30 Sep-5 Oct) to map day by day. Itinerary queries spike before Carnival 2027 (searches peak Jan); NYE readers too.
slots: day 5: Christ the Redeemer or Jardim Botânico

pieces.title: Rio de Janeiro : The Dossier
pieces.why: Practicalities luxury readers ask: safety, which beach posto, e-visa, money, NYE beach closures, transfers. Peak: NYE/Carnival planning.

pieces.title: The Comparison: Copacabana Palace vs Fairmont Rio
pieces.why: Same beach, two icons: she stayed Fairmont suite (5) and inspected Palace with GM. Palace pool wing reopens Nov-Dec 2026, LVMH spa coming: timely.
slots: hero: both on the Copacabana curve

pieces.title: The Rolodex: Rio de Janeiro
pieces.why: Address book: Gero (Fasano), Palace dining, Santa Teresa, beach bars. Gero alone is low-demand, so it lives here. Peak: NYE/Carnival.

pieces.title: Postcard From Iguazú Falls
pieces.why: Photo-led brand piece (film + digital) and social driver; supports the Verdict and Answer with internal links. Peak: Dec-Jan.

Rio de Janeiro Hotels: The Shortlist: One signature frame per hotel: Fasano rooftop pool over Ipanema, Palace white facade, Janeiro window to Leblon.
Prefer views with water/mountain in frame; readers save the view, not the lobby.
Consistent light/orientation across picks so the grid reads as a set.
The Answer: Brazil or Argentina Side of: The wide panorama only the Brazil side gives: whole horseshoe in one frame.
A people-for-scale shot on the Devil's Throat walkway, wet and dramatic.
Anything showing the river border/Argentina across helps answer the question visually.
The Verdict: Belmond Hotel das Cataratas: The pink colonial facade at first or last light, park empty: guests-only access is the story.
Room view toward the falls/forest; the pool with jungle edge.
Coco on the walkway before gates open; a dining plate at the terrace.
The Comparison: Copacabana vs Ipanema: Matched pairs: same time of day on each beach so the contrast reads.
Copacabana's wave-mosaic promenade; Ipanema sunset with Dois Irmãos.
Street-level life frames that show the feel of each neighbourhood.
The Verdict: Janeiro Hotel, Rio de Janei: The view from the bed in room 131 straight to the ocean: the save-worthy frame.
Design details: wood, linen, Osklen-style textures; rooftop pool at first light.
Coco in frame on the balcony; Leblon beach from the hotel.
The Primer: Rio de Janeiro: Postcard-scale landmarks with her own angle (Sugarloaf from Urca, Christ through cloud).
Arpoador sunset crowd; Santa Teresa colour.
Pick frames that work as section openers, wide and uncluttered.
The Answer: Do Americans Need a Visa for: Arrival frames: wing over Guanabara Bay, first look at the beach.
A still life of passport, film camera, boarding pass (no readable personal data).
Keep it light: one strong Rio hero is enough.
The Route: Five Days in Rio de Janeiro: One establishing frame per day plus one moment (meal, sunset).
Frames with time-of-day cues help readers sequence the route.
Favour places with addresses readers can actually go.
Rio de Janeiro : The Dossier: Useful-looking frames: beach posto flags, chairs and umbrella rentals, transfers.
Night frames for NYE/safety context, never people's faces up close.
The Comparison: Copacabana Palace vs Fai: Mirror the shots: pool vs pool, view vs view, dining vs dining.
Palace's pool and facade, Fairmont's rooftop and suite view over the curve.
Show renovation honestly only if tasteful; prefer finished spaces.
The Rolodex: Rio de Janeiro: Plates and tables in good light (Gero's pasta, a caipirinha on the sand).
Interiors with character over generic dishes.
One frame per entry, recognisable as that place.
Postcard From Iguazú Falls: Her best film frames: grain on mist, rainbow in spray.
Wildlife close-ups (coati, butterflies on skin) readers love to save.
A quiet abstract of water texture to close.
